title: Acceleration and Braking
source_docs: Vehicle Dynamics Blockset/Vehicle Scenarios/Drive Cycle and Maneuvers/Acceleration_and_Braking.md
text: 生成转向、加速和制动命令，输入 3 路、输出 2 路；{Maneuver start time, tStart [s]} 指定开始时间、{Longitudinal acceleration at tStart, ax [g]} 指定仿真开始时的纵向加速度、{Longitudinal velocity setpoint, velRef} 指定目标速度、{Longitudinal velocity setpoint units, velRefUnit []} 指定单位 mph、{Brake pedal actuation} 指定制动踏板触发方式、{Brake actuation time, tBrake [s]} 指定制动触发时间、{Longitudinal displacement of vehicle CG, xBrake [m]} 指定标称横向偏移、{Longitudinal deceleration at tBrake, axDecel [g]} 指定减速度、{Set handwheel angle to 0 deg after braking} 用于在制动后将方向盘转角设置为 0 度、{Enable fault tracking before braking} 用于启用制动前故障跟踪、{Transport delay buffer size, bufferSize []} 指定传输延迟缓冲区大小、{Longitudinal velocity and mean longitudinal velocity, velMaxDiff} 指定速度差、{Mean longitudinal velocity and longitudinal velocity reference, velMeanDiff} 指定速度容差、{Yaw velocity and mean yaw velocity, rMaxDiff [deg/s]} 指定速度容差、{Handwheel angle and mean handwheel angle, steerMaxDiff [deg]} 指定方向盘转角容差、{Stop Simulation when fault occurs} 用于在发生故障时停止仿真，按实例取值。

params.name: Longitudinal acceleration at tStart, ax [g]
params.values: 仿真开始时的纵向加速度 0.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Brake pedal actuation
params.values: 制动踏板触发方式 Time (default) | Longitudinal displacement

params.name: Brake actuation time, tBrake [s]
params.values: 制动触发时间 15 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Longitudinal displacement of vehicle CG, xBrake [m]
params.values: 标称横向偏移 200 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Set handwheel angle to 0 deg after braking
params.values: 用于在制动后将方向盘转角设置为 0 度的选项 on (default) | off

params.name: Enable fault tracking before braking
params.values: 用于启用制动前故障跟踪的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Transport delay buffer size, bufferSize []
params.values: 传输延迟缓冲区大小 4096 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Longitudinal velocity and mean longitudinal velocity, velMaxDiff
Mean longitudinal velocity and longitudinal velocity reference, velMeanDiff
Yaw velocity and mean yaw velocity, rMaxDiff [deg/s]
Handwheel angle and mean handwheel angle, steerMaxDiff [deg]
params.values: 方向盘转角容差 3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Stop Simulation when fault occurs
params.values: 用于在发生故障时停止仿真的选项 off (default) | on
